text:
When I came to Chillax for a massage, I had somehow lost hope of finding a truly great massage in Thailand. I still carried memories from my first visit in the early 2000s, when you could walk into almost any place and receive an exceptional massage. Unfortunately, that has changed. Today, it often takes a lot of research and many disappointing experiences to finally find a place like Chillax.

At Chillax, it’s immediately clear that the therapists are properly trained. They understand technique, anatomy, and the art of touch. The massage felt intentional, and deeply therapeutic.

As a holistic health practitioner with nearly three decades of experience in this field, I know very well what quality touch feels like. Polly was my massage therapist for the three sessions I had there, and her work was consistently excellent. I’m confident that the other therapists are equally well trained and knowledgeable, as the overall standard at Chillax is very high.

Nam, the owner, is a very lovely person and makes the experience even more special.

One of the best massages I’ve had in Hua Hin. Chillax Health Massage is very clean, peaceful, and professionally run – the whole atmosphere makes it easy to relax.

Nan and her team of therapists are exceptional. They work with skill, confidence  and understands how to relieve tension properly.

If you’re looking for a quality Thai massage in Hua Hin, I highly recommend Chillax Health Massage. Professional, knowledgeable, and a spotless environment. I’ll definitely be returning.

Just had a deep tissue massage and it was so nice. She completely eliminated some knots in my leg and worked pretty hard on my back, while checking if I was okay. So respectful and a very thorough massage. They also do pregnancy massages and my girl will check it out soon.

Amazing experience from start to finish! I went with my family, and all of us absolutely loved it. The ambience was soothing, and the staff, including the owner, were very kind, polite, and professional. The massage was fantastic—we left feeling relaxed and refreshed. We’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend!

I had a superb massage provided by Ms. Tik, 2hours Aromatic relax massage. Firm as I requested with no follow up bruises which is rare and sign of truly skilled masseuse. The entire saloon is very nice, professionally designed, and i requested in advance if possible to shower and it was possible. The missing star was only due to really missing a glass of any kind of fluids afterwards, as much as really needed it. However, if anywhere to return for quality massage it would be here.

Had my very first facial massage here. An amazing experience. When you walk in you are greeted with a friendly welcome and while the foyer is small, it is very well presented and clean. The massage staff are great as well. Very well dressed and excellent at their craft. I’m going back for a Thai massage and I have no doubt it will also be great. This husband and wife team have been in the industry for many years and operated overseas. Highly recommend them. HIGHLY!
Very good massage! They have a variety of different options and the quality is good and price decent. Owner and staff are also very friendly! Would definitely recommend this shop!

The type of massage in this studio is distinctly different from the usual local massage parlors. One can always be lucky elsewhere and find a good masseuse who understands her craft, but that remains a lottery. Not so at Chillax Studio. The masseuses practice their profession with passion and competence. The Thai massage was truly outstanding and lives up to its name. I have never had a better massage elsewhere than here. I can recommend the studio without reservation, and the price is completely acceptable
Excellent massage which I meet, relax after that, nice ladies and the owner is super friendly, she shares bread shop, Thailand restaurant to me, definitely I will visit again
The massage we had was very reasonable considering the price. Even though, they don't have male masseurs the women who did the massage where luckily strong enough.
The therapist Pat and Polly are very good. Amazing massages and they truly care for you. The owners are very friendly and welcoming. Best massages in Hua Hin!

My wife just had a 90mim foot massage there today and she is really picky with her massage and she said this is a proper massage shop so if you are looking for a real good Massage then Chillax is the place for you. 🙏🏻 …

I have visited Nan for a massage three times already. I usually get a back massage, and it truly makes me feel better. Nan carefully and thoroughly works on problem areas, and my shoulders feel much better. I also had a facial massage and was very pleased with the results—my face looked fresh and lifted. My husband tried a leg massage after his workout, and he also really enjoyed it. The massage was strong, thorough, and relaxing at the same time. Thank you so much for your excellent work!

Found the new favorite massage place in Huahin. Khun Pat was amazing! My knee was a little sore before and now I feel no pain. Soo good sooo relaxing. All staff were very professional and friendly. I will be back! 🥰 …

Had my first Traditional Thai massage here and it was outstanding. Highly recommend. I wish I had found this place sooner so I could have had more massages here before we left. Good pressure and getting into all my tight spots, plus the stretches made it so I have way more movement in my joints than I have had in a long time.
An excellent place for a 90-120 mins sport massage (with Polly). Been there 3 times already and will keep coming.
Very good massage, and for a decent price as well. Great service, and lovely conversations with both the owner and massage therapists.

My brother and I both got Health massages from this wonderful therapy place. It's a very relaxed environment and the masseuse is really know what they are doing and practicing, I was very impressed and continue to be by their skill and knowledge. I highly recommend getting a 1 hour to 1 1/2 hour massage because it takes a lot of time for them to really do their work and they will tell you that less time minimizes what they're able to do to help you walk away fully treated.

My husband and I recently visited our favourite massage place in Hua Hin for a 2-hour aromatherapy massage, and as always, we left feeling rejuvenated. We've been regulars since the time they were located right across from our place, and even though they've moved closer to Bluport mall, their exceptional quality and warm hospitality remain unchanged.

We've explored almost all the well-known massage spots in Hua Hin, and this place consistently stands out as the best. The therapists here clearly know their craft and demonstrated impressive skill and training every time. The beds are spacious and they are generous with the amount of oil used.

The owners are genuinely lovely people, always greeting us with kindness and warmth. I love the fact that they serve hot tea after our sessions, giving us the chance to relax and enjoy a nice chat with the owners before leaving. On top of the wonderful service and atmosphere, their pricing is incredibly affordable.

If you're looking for an exceptionally therapeutic massage, we cannot recommend this place enough. We'll definitely keep coming back!

I am almost hesitant to post a review because I am worried I won’t be able to get an appt after everyone finds Chillax. The owner is really lovely and warm. The spa is clean and quiet since it isnt on the main drag. You can easily take a Bolt/ Grab if it’s too far from your place. Me and my husband had our first Thai massage and it was great. They were kind and patient since it was our first time. We have already booked a second time.

Have been a regular for almost 3 years and my wife and I always enjoyed our massage sessions every time we come here. The owner is highly skilled and knows how to treat every ache and injury well. We have tried so many masseuses in Hua Hin and so far Chillax is one of the best! As mentioned by many, the place is clean, well lit and comfortable.

Hubby and I had a 1hr massage here today!
2 amazing ladies who know what they are doing and how to massage properly. We had the office syndrome massage. …

they deserve much more costumers!
Best massage I had so far in Thailand. I have been here for a few years now. This massage was really good. After a good session of Muay Thai, when everything hurts. The therapist did an amazing job putting me back on my feet.
Thank you so much !

The best professional massage in Thailand!
I’ve been visiting it for 3 years. Everyone is polite and open-hearted! I do recommend it for everyone who wants to relax and get good mood🔥 …
Nice clean massage place but nothing special in terms of the massage itself ( according to my own experience) 400 TBH

This is hands down the best massage place I’ve experienced in Hua Hin over the past four years. All the masseuses are incredibly well-trained, and the quality of their service truly stands out. My personal favorite is Nan—her technique and attentiveness are exceptional.

Booking an appointment is effortless through WhatsApp, and the staff are always welcoming, greeting you with warm smiles and kind words. What truly sets this place apart is their ability to quickly identify problem areas and tailor the massage to your specific needs. Whether you have knots, injuries, or tension, they adapt their approach to provide real relief and lasting results.

This is not your typical touristy spot but a professional massage establishment where quality and care come first. I highly recommend making a booking in advance, as they are often in demand. If you’re in Hua Hin and looking for a massage that genuinely helps, this is the place to go!

I've been to this massage parlor for the second time. This is the best massage I have ever had in Thailand and I have lived in this country for over 11 years.  I can particularly recommend the masseuse Khun Pad.  After the second massage I already felt like I was reborn.  Everything is very clean and all the staff are very nice and professional.

This place and the experience is incredible. True professionals! The whole experience is pure relaxation and tranquility. I'm a blue collar worker and after years of neglecting my body i went here while on vacation, for a 2hr deep tissue sports massage. While my girlfriend got an aroma massage. It was painful but felt so good, and it was much needed. You get a strange feeling of really being cared for! Im going back on saturday, and the day before we leave again. Would 1000% recommend!

Simply. WOW.

The lady was simply outstandingly supreme. She was like as smooth as Thai silk for real 😁. But in all seriousness, this was one of the best massages I have ever had. So much so I have already booked my return.

An absolute 10! I have some significant tightening in my back and was looking for someone to help me relieve it.  My wife got a traditional Thai massage and she loved it. The place is a little bit off the beaten path but well, well, worth it.

My wife and I have been visiting Hua Hin for the last month and we were looking for a great spa for a massage.  We totally found it at Chillax Health Massage!  We loved the first one so much that we booked another, then another!  Every massage was amazing!  I was lucky to get Nan as my massage therapist every time and she is wonderful!  Everyone here is friendly and they make you feel comfortable and welcome.  We highly recommend Chillax and will definitely come back whenever we are in Hua Hin!

My family and I have been visiting this salon for the last three years when we come on vacation to Hua Hin. What to say? Excellent massage parlor. Masseurs are masters of their craft, great professionals. Various, topical massages relevant …

Wonderful massage experience in Hua Hin.  A relaxing, therapeutic massage from Ken who applied the right amount of pressure for the entire treatment (not too hard, not too soft) reading my body and what it needed.  Cost just a little more than other local shops but the quality is so much more here. The couple, who are the owners, speak excellent English and provide a comfortable environment to enjoy a massage experience.  Highly recommend and will return during my stay in Hua Hin.
Got a Thai massage today. Felt amazing when I left!
By far the best deep tissue sports massage in Hua Hin
Had an amazing 90 minute massage here with my husband. Booked last minute and they fit us in, messaging via WhatsApp. They're super friendly owners and we'll definitely be back! ❤️

I've just had my first Thai oil massage along with my wife and 10yr daughter at chillax health massage and we enjoyed it very much. The place is super clean and the massage therapists are very professional. Definitely recommend the  place.

I’ve been waiting to get a massage for a long time, so I decided to select  this place when it reopened.  Therapist and treatment room hygiene.   Hands was sanitized before treatment which was my concern. Therapist wore a mask during a treatment. Bed sheet and pillow sheet was removed after treatment.  Therapist was professional and talented.

I would definitely recommend this place to my friends and travelers who want a spa-like experience at a low cost with excellent skill and service. Thank you so much for taking a good care of my husband and me.

The owner and the therapists are so so friendly and welcome. It was very relaxing during the session. They took us after their business hour, and when We finished our massage at midnight, they even offer to drive us back to our hotel. A …
Great traditional Thai massage at a fair price. Small, clean facility. Nan and Pat are both very good!
The best massage  I've ever had, they are great, fantastic! Definitely need to comeback again❤️

Honestly the best massage I’ve had ever. can’t recommend this place enough. Great owners and professional massages. Tried a few other places in the area and nothing came close. If you’ve in Hua Hin and want a massage, you HAVE to go here.
Best massage I have ever had!! I have a lot of pain in my lower back and this helped out so much - couldn’t be more impressed 👏 …

After reading a positive review recommending the sport massage, I gave chillax a go. I have to say I was positively surprised and it definitely ranked in the top 3 massages I ever had. Only can recommend them and thank me later :)

The be best massage service in Hua Hin.
Nan and Dew are very friendly and nice people. They both speak good English.
The main thing is that the salon is incredible clean, everywhere: in changing rooms and in bathroom.
All masseurs are very attentive to your needs.
Aoi does intense massage. Pom does deep slow massage. Love it!
But for me - Nan (owner) is the best.
I always come with my 3 y.o daughter and Dew makes her “waiting for mom time” - interesting. Great place!

Wife and I went there 3 times during our 6 days stay in Hua Hin. All thanks to the other reviewers. Massage is a hit or miss thing in Thailand, and they do not disappoint. Their prices brought shame to the bigger chains around the area.
Highly recommended.
The best massage I had in my life. They are not just professional they are masters of massage. Very friendly staff. Must come if here if you want excellent and reasonable priced massage.

I haven't had many massages in my life. That being said, this was THE BEST massage I've ever had. The staff was eager and happy to have us. They did things to my body that not only did I not know I wanted, they did things that I NEEDED! There were times that I felt like a human surf board and there were times that I felt like a pretzel. I thoroughly enjoyed all the times and plan on going back during my short stay. There are MANY places to get a massage in Hua Hin. This place was my needle in a haystack. I hugged the woman when she was done with me. They took our picture. I love them.

If you wanna have a very good massage from extremely professional therapist than search no longer. We (my girlfriend and I) had the best massage here so we went back several timed. The team is very experienced and friendly. My girlfriend …

The therapists gave a warm welcome to myself and two small children on a rainy morning. They treated us all to a very relaxing massage and my youngest was so chilled she fell asleep! The spa is clean and professional and I would wholeheartedly recommend a visit.

Excellent remedial Thai massage from Khun Pat - one of the best Thai massages I have had in Thailand or Australia. A good strong massage and a professional and friendly operation. I will be back many times I am sure. 700THB for 90 minutes of a massage of that quality was good value.
spent_amount: Excellent remedial Thai massage from Khun Pat - one of the best Thai massages I have had in Thailand or Australia. A good strong massage and a professional and friendly operation. I will be back many times I am sure. 700THB for 90 minutes of a massage of that quality was good value.

text:
This is the best! I went to Hua Hin for a relaxing massage and found Chillax. I wasn't disappointed at all! I have problems with neck, shoulder, and back pain that requires regular massages. The masseuse, whose name is Pat, recommended a sports massage. She was amazing and I felt so relaxed. I will definitely go back there again.
The place is very clean, quiet, and smells of aromatherapy – very relaxing.

Highly recommended. Very nice, clean place, friendly owner and therapist, speaks English, massage was as deep as I asked. Didn't notice how long it took.

I recommend it. Clean and pleasant place. Friendly owner and experienced therapist. They took my requests into account.
Great massage. Fantastic service. We all had a great experience
We went there twice in two days, the owners are very friendly, the massages are exceptional, a must in Hua Hin!
Excellent massage. The staff is trained and certified. They have many years of experience. The place is very clean.
I liked it. Tnanks for the office massage

Dear Chillax Health Massage Team,

I am incredibly grateful to have found your salon. The moment you arrive, you notice the difference compared to many other massage parlors – you're not approached on the street, but are allowed to settle in at your own pace. You truly address individual physical ailments, which I greatly appreciate.

The salon is exceptionally clean, quiet, and exudes a special atmosphere of well-being. I have been suffering from mental health issues for some time, and the massages have been incredibly beneficial. Each visit has helped me to completely let go of worries and anxieties for a while.

Your salon is a place where one feels safe, understood, and relaxed. I am very grateful for the many massages I received during my vacation in Hua Hin. I will especially never forget the lovely owner.

If I am ever in the area again, I will definitely visit you again – I promise.

Thank you so much for everything.
Another amazing relaxing visit to Chillax. Nan gave me a Collegen Facial. Just so good. Thank you Nan ka 🙏 …

Chillax Health Massage is a fantastic massage salon.

I have been visiting Thailand for 27 years and find that you get the very best massages here.

The masseuses are highly skilled and can read your body. If you have problems with your neck or shoulders, for example, they will resolve them here. They have nice massage tables with a head opening. They use fine towels and fine oil or balm. The owners speak good English.

Are you looking for a massage salon that is clean, tidy, and where you get high-quality massages? Then go straight to Chillax Health Massage.
If you want a good Thai massage from someone who knows what they are doing, Chillax is highly recommended.
The owners are lovely, friendly, and very hospitable. You'll feel like they're friends or family. The staff do a great job. It's well worth the visit.
20/10 massage. Best massage I’ve ever had. And I’ve had over 10,000 massages so you can trust me
Wonderful massage  - great price
Great massage. Very professional. Highly recommended.
Unbelievable, if you want a real Thai or rehabilitative message there is no better on Hua Hin. 10 stars out of five, we will be going back very soon.
Very good masseuses who really know what they are doing. Been here twice and the older lady managed to loosen up my neck.
Best massage in town. They offer various massage techniques and can respond to individual problems like pain and injuries.
This lady knows what she is doing. I can highly recommend this place
